CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation condition linked to identified content/presentation.

COD.rationale: Identified content (red coordinates) and a separate organization/access status (origin with executed_branch_claim) are both explicitly recorded for the same candidate referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition is linked to the identified contents' presentation or access.

C.rationale: Multiple literal records identify content (red/blue) with coordinate attributes across named referents and times.

D.rationale: The report separately lists the content coordinates and an origin/status field (executed_branch_claim=false) for the same candidate referent/time.

O.rationale: The text describes presentation/layout and includes origin/provenance metadata indicating how contents are organized/accessed.
